name: js-merge-intervals
instruction: Implement mergeIntervals.js (CommonJS): module.exports = mergeIntervals. Takes an array of [start, end] pairs, returns them sorted by start with overlapping OR ADJACENT intervals merged ([1,3] and [3,5] merge into [1,5]; [1,3] and [4,5] do NOT). Input may be unsorted. Do not mutate the input or its pairs. Throw a RangeError for any pair where start > end. Empty input returns [].
verifyCmd: node -e "const m=require('./mergeIntervals.js');const eq=(a,b)=>JSON.stringify(a)===JSON.stringify(b);if(!eq(m([[1,3],[2,6],[8,10]]),[[1,6],[8,10]]))process.exit(1);if(!eq(m([[8,10],[1,3]]),[[1,3],[8,10]])){console.error('unsorted');process.exit(1)}if(!eq(m([[1,3],[3,5]]),[[1,5]])){console.error('adjacent must merge');process.exit(1)}if(!eq(m([[1,3],[4,5]]),[[1,3],[4,5]])){console.error('gap must not merge');process.exit(1)}if(!eq(m([]),[]))process.exit(1);const src=[[3,4],[1,2]];m(src);if(!eq(src,[[3,4],[1,2]])){console.error('mutated input');process.exit(1)}try{m([[5,1]]);console.error('no throw');process.exit(1)}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof RangeError))process.exit(1)}console.log('ok')"
